from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
import json,re,hashlib,math
receipt=Path('/workspace/.cloud-setup/fp06-play-2026-10-12/BALANCE/math-receipt.json')
d=json.loads(receipt.read_text())
source=Path(d['worktree'])/'apps/weltraum-browser/src/factory/catalog/fp02Catalog.ts'
text=source.read_text()
expected=next(x['sha256'] for x in d['sourceInventory'] if x['path']=='apps/weltraum-browser/src/factory/catalog/fp02Catalog.ts')
assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected,'Source bytes drift: old receipt remains historical'
num=lambda s:int(s.replace('_',''))
items={a:(basis,num(mass)) for a,basis,mass in re.findall(r'item\("([^"]+)",\s*"[^"]+",\s*"[^"]+",\s*"(mg|piece|mm)",\s*([\d_]+)',text)}
section=text.split('const recipes: readonly FactoryRecipe[] = freeze([')[1].split('\n]);')[0]
blocks=re.split(r'\n  (?=recipe\()',section)
count=0
for block in blocks:
 if 'recipe(' not in block:continue
 m=re.search(r'recipe\("([^"]+)",\s*"([^"]+)",\s*\[(.*?)\],\s*\[(.*?)\],\s*\[(.*?)\]\)',block,re.S)
 assert m
 rid,runtime,ins,outs,process=m.groups()
 terms=lambda s:[{'itemId':a,'quantityUnits':num(b)} for a,b in re.findall(r'term\("([^"]+)",\s*([\d_]+)\)',s)]
 inputs,outputs=terms(ins),terms(outs)
 mass=lambda ts:sum(x['quantityUnits']*items[x['itemId']][1] for x in ts)
 assert mass(inputs)==mass(outputs)
 captured=next(x for x in d['recipes'] if x['id']==rid)
 assert captured['definition']['inputs']==inputs and captured['definition']['outputs']==outputs
 canonical=json.dumps(captured['definition'],sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=False)
 assert canonical.isascii()
 h=0x811c9dc5
 for c in canonical:h=((h^ord(c))*0x01000193)&0xffffffff
 assert captured['staticDerivedRecipeDigest']==f'fnv1a:{h:08x}'
 for p in captured['processRates']:
  ms=p['process']['durationMs']
  if ms is None:assert p['nominalRates'] is None;continue
  for side,ts in [('inputs',inputs),('outputs',outputs)]:
   for term,flow in zip(ts,p['nominalRates'][side]):
    basis,um=items[term['itemId']]
    assert F(flow['kgPerMinute'])==F(term['quantityUnits']*um*60000,ms*1000000)
    if basis=='piece':assert F(flow['piecesPerMinute'])==F(term['quantityUnits']*60000,ms)
 count+=1
assert count==7
cargo=text.split('const cargoRows:')[1].split('\n];')[0]
rows=re.findall(r'\["(C\d+)",\s*"[^"]+",\s*([\d_]+),\s*([\d_]+)\]',cargo)
assert len(rows)==28
cargoMass=sum(items[list(items)[i]][1]*num(q) for i,(_,q,v) in enumerate(rows))
cargoVolume=sum(num(v) for _,q,v in rows)
def ratio(s,need):
 s,need=F(s),F(need);den=math.lcm(s.denominator,need.denominator);a,b=int(s*den),int(need*den);g=math.gcd(a,b);return [b//g,a//g]
checks=[
 ('current-v1-seven-recipes-mass',count==7),
 ('current-v1-cargo',cargoMass==2984400000 and cargoVolume==12450000000),
 ('W09-brace-total',F(16)==F('5.8')+3+5+F('2.2')),
 ('W09-process-work',2*36000+2*80000==232000),
 ('v1-CUT-Former-ratio',ratio(15,F(45,4))==[3,4]),
 ('v1-planned-profile-assembly-ratio',ratio(F(21,2),8)==[16,21]),
 ('v1-planned-sheet-assembly-ratio',ratio(F(21,2),4)==[8,21]),
 ('v2-ratios',all(ratio(s,n)==v for s,n,v in [(60,60,[1,1]),(30,15,[1,2]),(15,10,[2,3]),(20,30,[3,2])])),
 ('v2-metal-mass',F(30)==25+5 and 25==15+10 and 25==5*5),
 ('v2-metal-power',F('1.5')+2+F('2.5')+3==9),
 ('v2-metal-energy',F('9.5')*1000*60==570000),
 ('v2-unit5-rates',all(F(x)%5==0 for x in [30,25,5,15,10,60])),
 ('v2-halfclock',F(15)*F(1,2)==F('7.5')),
 ('ore-element-budget',60*F('.3')==30*F('.54')+30*F('.06')),
 ('band-travel-discrete',math.ceil(F(4000,75))==54),
 ('band-smallpacket-service',F(5)*60/F('5.5')==F(600,11)),
 ('band-v2-batch-policy',F(7500000)*60/15==30000000),
 ('battery-energy',F(12960000000,1000)==12960000 and F(14400000000,1000)==14400000),
 ('optional-cut-S',F(20)==15+5 and F('1.5')/F('.5')==3),
 ('optional-cut-M',F(40)==30+10 and F(2)/F('.5')==4),
 ('chemistry-stoichiometric-mass',F('159.687')+3*F('28.010')==2*F('55.845')+3*F('44.009')),
 ('v2-control-aux-energy',(F('9.5')+F('.1'))*1000*60==576000),
 ('v2-battery-deficit',F('2.7')/F('.95')==F(54,19)),
 ('v2-batch-wholepiece',5==int(5) and F(5)*F(5)==25),
 ('v2-line-packet-space',F('7.5')<=10 and F('5.5')<=15 and F('7.5')<=15),
 ('ore-gangue-budget',F(42)==F('13.8')+F('28.2'))]
assert len(checks)==26
for name,condition in checks:
 assert condition,name
 print('PASS',name)
print('PASS 26 rational checks; 7 source recipes and 28 cargo positions; runtime/browser/save NOT_RUN')
